description: Department of Local Government (Western Province) - Announce that a meeting of selecting a new Chairman for the vacated Chairman's position of Kotikawatta Mulleriyawa Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette notification announces a meeting to select a new Chairman for a local authority (Kotikawatte Mulleriyawa Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. This content specifically relates to electoral processes at the local government level, specifically filling a vacated elected position, which falls under the Elections category (Type 7) for electoral processes and related matters.
